h: US Justice Department reportedly charges two former FBI officials over testimony on Hunter Biden laptop
p: The US Justice Department has reportedly charged two former FBI officials in connection with their testimony about the Hunter Biden laptop. Details of the charges have not been fully set out in the reports seen so far. Lawyers for the two have not been quoted.
more: The laptop story has been a political flashpoint in the US for years.
The two are presumed innocent unless proven otherwise.
